parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const i=$json,b=i.body??i;if(String(i.headers?.['x-webhook-secret']??'')!==$env.PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET)throw new Error('unauthorized');for(const k of['provider','providerEventId','invoiceNumber','currency','amountMinor','occurredAt'])if(b[k]===undefined||b[k]==='')throw new Error('invalid payment event');const evidenceType=$env.PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_MODE==='provider_verified'?'provider_verified':'simulated';return[{json:{...b,evidenceType,idempotencyKey:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b.provider+':'+b.providerEventId).digest('hex')}}];

parameters.query: WITH p AS(INSERT INTO payment_events(provider,provider_event_id,idempotency_key,invoice_number,currency,amount_minor,event_type,payload,evidence_type,occurred_at)VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'payment_succeeded',$7::jsonb,$9,$8::timestamptz)ON CONFLICT(provider,provider_event_id)DO NOTHING RETURNING id,invoice_number,currency,amount_minor),i AS(SELECT p.id payment_event_id,v.id invoice_id,v.invoice_number,v.currency,v.total_minor,v.amount_paid_minor,v.balance_minor FROM p LEFT JOIN invoices v ON v.invoice_number=p.invoice_number),m AS(UPDATE invoices SET amount_paid_minor=amount_paid_minor+$6,balance_minor=balance_minor-$6,status=CASE WHEN balance_minor-$6=0 THEN 'paid' ELSE 'partially_paid' END,updated_at=now(),version=version+1 WHERE id=(SELECT invoice_id FROM i)AND currency=$5 AND $6>0 AND $6<=balance_minor RETURNING id),x AS(INSERT INTO reconciliation_exceptions(payment_event_id,invoice_number,reason)SELECT payment_event_id,$4,CASE WHEN invoice_id IS NULL THEN 'invoice_mismatch' WHEN currency<>$5 THEN 'currency_mismatch' WHEN $6<=0 THEN 'invalid_amount' WHEN $6>balance_minor THEN 'overpayment_requires_review' ELSE 'unknown' END FROM i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m)RETURNING id)SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m)matched,(SELECT id FROM x)exception_id;
